snippet.title: ULTRAPOOL Announcement Trailer | offbrand games
snippet.description:
🎱 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4195110/Ultrapool
📲 Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.icedropgames.pool
🍎 Apple App Store: https://testflight.apple.com/join/X46s4yKn

offbrand games is publishing Ultrapool on Steam, Google Play and iOS! It's the pool-like roguelike full of crazy balls 🔥

Wishlist now + play the demo for a chance to try the game early and give us feedback on the experience!

Discord: https://discord.gg/nzgzRxch4G

----------------------------------

About the game:

Get comfy, choose a cocktail, and get ready for a very special game of pool. Assemble a triangle of balls with strange effects and get the sickest trickshots. The bartenders won't be easy to impress!

Ultrapool is an arcade-y colorful billiards roguelike full of wild ball-based synergies! Pocketing balls gives you score, and extra score gives you money you can spend at the bar to buy and improve your set of balls. Try to survive 10 rounds!

----------------------------------
